from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,subprocess

r=Path.cwd()
out=r/"reports/research/510300_202212_native_business_expectation_interpretation_source_v1"
if out.exists():
    raise RuntimeError("该固定原件资格目录已存在，禁止覆盖或重复登记")
out.mkdir()
at=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def rel(p):
    return str(Path(p).relative_to(r)).replace("\\","/")
def ref(p):
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
parents=[
    r/"reports/research/510300_manufacturing_business_expectation_joint_source_v1/protocol_source.json",
    r/"reports/research/510300_manufacturing_business_expectation_joint_source_v1/result.json",
    r/"reports/research/510300_manufacturing_business_expectation_joint_source_v1/2022年12月同原表与正文只有方法名无经营预期当前原量_E121.json",
    r/"reports/research/510300_official_pmi_interpretation_cause_source_qualification_v1/protocol.json",
    r/"reports/research/510300_nonmanufacturing_demand_expectation_source_contract_v1/protocol.json"]
refs=[ref(p) for p in parents]
assert refs[0]["sha256"]=="f553b2fcb699d163a4db7f443f173e1108bc2f8d7a9d9c88fe0f2aa6ee4136d0"
assert refs[1]["sha256"]=="1683643e22cddaa3c6a9032fbf346bc6e9e7d03285836d36eb832122f6ac3515"
protocol={
    "study_id":"510300_202212_NATIVE_BUSINESS_EXPECTATION_INTERPRETATION_SOURCE_V1","experiment_id":"E122",
    "registered_at":at,"status":"REGISTERED_BEFORE_ONE_DIFFERENT_OFFICIAL_INTERPRETATION_LOOKUP",
    "question":"2022年12月PMI同期官方解读是否直接公布制造业生产经营活动预期当月原量及自己公开钟？原数据表无列不能单独证明不同原解读没有公布。",
    "closest_completed_direction":"E121固定132原数据页/当月表与继承保守钟资格已关闭，原2022-12未知与所有结果不改；E38仅2024-01/02/03不同解读，E49为非制造业三问项，不重试其固定对象。",
    "material_source_difference":"一个此前本限定原路由未绑定的同期官方原解读对象；若明确给出原未得数值，则新增当前本地原信息。只是新增资格问题，不宣称新经济机制/独立根事件/金融增量。",
    "prior_lookup":"限定data/raw/macro文件名2022-12/202212未找到同期官方解读，只见原数据页与其他宏观文件；有限docs/config/research用途搜索未绑定本对象。不能由有限检索认证全repo绝无原件。",
    "target_stat_month":"2022-12","target_publisher":"国家统计局","target_document":"高级统计师赵庆河解读2022年12月中国采购经理指数",
    "selection_rule":"一官方搜索后只取最先满足国家统计局/2022年12月PMI同期解读标题的原页；不按是否有期望数值、价格或股票结果挑来源；无精确标题即NO_LOCATED_SOURCE，不扩月/换机构。",
    "fixed_query":{"q":"site:stats.gov.cn 赵庆河 解读 2022年12月 中国采购经理指数","domains":["stats.gov.cn"]},
    "request_budget":{"official_search_queries":1,"first_official_page_GET":1,"redirect_requests":0,"retries":0,"alternate_carriers":0,"authenticated_requests":0},
    "extraction_contract":"完整正文制造业段必须明示当前2022-12的生产经营活动预期指数数值；只有方法名/定性/后来月份回看不算。若正文不同量或范围歧义UNKNOWN，不从非制造业业务活动预期替代。",
    "clock_contract":"原页完整标题、正文/月度身份、显示公开日期/时刻和原meta分别留存；只有日期则事前保守当日23:59:59，日内UNKNOWN。URL迁移日期和当前取得时刻不替代原公开钟；历史首版仍未认证。",
    "admission_contract":"本对象只有原量和自己钟可辨才获得历史来源资格；不改E121的原132值或继承23:59:59键，不将本一对象自动当完整1212/1711支持或金融准入。必要完整共同支持必须另核，股票标签未读。",
    "scope_correction":"过去的NO_PROGRESS/blocked是当时已登记候选状态，不是全部其他官方原件不存在的实证；来源未知不等于经济方向被证伪。当前新原件问题的执行只有实际新增证据才算进展。",
    "financial_budget":{"new_candidates":0,"new_fits":0,"linear_regressions":0,"weighted_scores":0,"new_stock_labels":0,"new_accounts":0,"existing_source_code_edits":0},
    "completion_rule":"这一固定原件有限首定位/首GET一次后裁决并结束；失败/无量/无钟如实保存，不在本候选扩来源、数值/月份或参数救援。",
    "parents":refs,"goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False,"net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED",
    "historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False,"independent_validation":False,"new_blind_sample":False,
    "current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,"prospective_forecasts":False}
(out/"protocol.json").write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
(out/"原件资格认领_E122.json").write_text(json.dumps({"at":at,"state":"REGISTERED_NOT_RUN","new_source_object":protocol["target_document"],
    "old_E121_route_and_unknown_retained":True,"no_stock_labels_or_models":True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
status=subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--short","--untracked-files=no"],cwd=r,text=True,encoding="utf-8").strip()
(out/"运行前git记录_E122.json").write_text(json.dumps({"at":at,"status":status},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"E122":"仅不同原官方解读资格登记","固定统计月":"2022-12","查询/首GET预算":"1/1，0重试","金融预算":0,
    "protocol_sha256":ref(out/"protocol.json")["sha256"]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
